messages:
acme_dev: Hey @maria, after rotating the API key this morning our prod service started getting 401 invalid_api_key. Nothing changed in code, just the rotation. Happening from our k8s backend only, not local. Any ideas?

maria_support: Can you paste a minimal curl or the header your service is sending (redact the secret)? Also which deployment (hosted/dedicated/private) and region?

acme_dev: Hosted (us-west1). Here's the exact request our service emits (redacted):

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: ApiKey \"eyJhbGciOi...wXYZ==\"" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-infer","input":"hi"}'
```

acme_dev: Notice the inner double quotes around the token — we don't add those in code, we pull from k8s secret via Helm templating.

aj: Hmm looks like the header value actually contains the quote characters. Our auth parser expects the raw token after the space, so the leading/ending '"' will break signature lookup. In logs auth_error=invalid_api_key, key_lookup=failed (raw="\"eyJhbGci...")

kira: @acme_dev what does your Helm template look like where you set the secret? Common gotcha: using the Helm `quote` func when rendering a value into a secret will add extra quotes into the stored string. Example bad: `value: {{ .Values.apiKey | quote }}` -> secret contains the literal quotes.

acme_dev: Oh wow, we do use `{{ .Values.apiKey | quote }}` in our secret manifest. That explains it. We thought quoting was safe.

maria_support: Yep — secrets should store the raw token bytes. Two quick fixes: 1) Update Helm to remove `| quote` and reapply the secret (kubectl apply) + restart pods, or 2) rotate the key and push a new secret value without quotes. Either will fix the header sent.

kira: If you can't rotate immediately, you can patch the deployment to strip quotes in an init step, e.g. `export RDW_KEY=${RDW_KEY%\"}` but that's a band-aid.

auth-bot: detected_event: api_auth_failure, org=acme-inc, route=/v1/generate, sampled_log_id=log-2026-03-18-17

acme_dev: Removed `| quote`, re-applied secret, rolled pods. Verified with curl (no extra quotes) and requests now return 200. Confirmed resolved. Thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:

maria_support: Glad that was it — marking as resolved. Leaving note on the incident: helm `quote` can add literal quotes to secrets, causing Authorization header mismatches (401 invalid_api_key).
